page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating the resource sharing and performance variability associated with hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all disk operations must utilize network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The lack of local NVMe SSDs represents a tradeoff, as disk-intensive workloads will be bound by network storage latency and throughput limits. However, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed provide consistent, predictable compute performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge offers high compute density due to its dedicated non-hyperthreaded cores, making it suitable for workloads where predictable CPU performance is critical. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions it as a general-purpose instance with compute-heavy characteristics. Appropriate workloads include application servers, medium-sized databases, build systems, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require sustained CPU performance without GPU acceleration.
